proof.matrix_sandwich: l Q0 <= Q_u <= u Q0 for all HU, with 0<l and l<=u<=2l.
proof.energy_definition: x_j=w_j^H Q0 w_j>=0, S=sum over all original J streams x_j<=P lambda_max(Q0).
proof.SINR_upper: gamma_u <= u x_u / (l (S-x_u)+1); all original J interference and one normalized AWGN are retained.
proof.convexity: f(x)=log2((l S+1+(u-l)x)/(l S+1-l x)) is increasing and convex on0<=x<=S when u<=2l.
proof.simplex_extreme: max sum_u f(x_u) subject x_u>=0,sum_HU x_u<=S occurs at one vertex, so sum rate <= log2(1+u S).
proof.bound: Therefore sum_HU log2(1+gamma_u) <= log2(1+u P lambda_max(Q0)). Dropping NHU QoS can only enlarge the feasible set.
proof.limitation: This bounds the source approximate ratio-of-expected-powers metric under CURRENT declared full16-feed moments. It is not a bound on unrecovered author means, isotropic-mu simplification, receive gain or original figure inputs, and not an exact Elog upper bound.
